answer: Require a 30-day refundable bond per public key and a fresh key-bound task each epoch. A copied echo fails because the task seed includes that key. Across a canyon of aliases, an attacker must immobilize N bonds and fund N independent computations, not merely generate N keys. Keep the maximum reward below task cost plus the bond's opportunity cost, adjusting the cap as costs change. An ocean of identities then loses money at the margin. Refund honest bonds; slash only signed equivocation.
